entries.text: An Aries can hear you getting over them. Like a dog whistle.
Every Taurus has one blanket they would testify in court for.
Geminis don't sleep. They just close all 400 tabs at once.
A Cancer's "im fine" has 47 layers. Scientists have only reached layer 3.
A Leo has never lost an argument. Witnesses, yes. Arguments, never.
Virgos alphabetize their emotions and file grief under "later"
A Libra spent 45 minutes choosing this gradient. It was the wrong one.
A Sagittarius is legally required to mention their trip abroad every 11 minutes.
Capricorns rest by working on something else.
An Aquarius has 900 friends and 0 people who know their address.
Pisces cry at commercials for products they already own.
